lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in a grid-like lattice of approximately 4-5 visible horizontal rows and 10+ vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form localized grid nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges characterized by a superior-facing high-luminance edge and an inferior-facing shadow gradient, running parallel across the upper flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse, low-contrast high-luminance blobs located primarily near the base of the first dorsal fin; density decreases significantly toward the apex and trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple ectoparasitic organisms (remoras) visible: one prominently attached to the distal dorsal surface of the right pectoral fin, and at least two others located ventrally to the mid-flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition of spot morphology on the right pectoral fin from large, sparse proximal blobs to high-density, small-diameter pixel clusters toward the distal margin.
